careerDirection.directionDescription: Human-AI interaction and UX research involves understanding how people interact with AI-powered systems and designing those interactions to be safe, useful, and trustworthy. UX researchers conduct user studies of AI products; user research analysts synthesise feedback from AI users; inclusive design analysts ensure AI interfaces work for diverse populations. BCA AI & ML graduates who develop psychology, research methods, and design thinking skills can build alternate careers in the nascent field of responsible AI design.

careerDirection.directionName: AI in Business Analytics & Decision Support
careerDirection.directionDescription: AI-driven business analytics involves using machine learning models and statistical tools to support business decision-making — demand forecasting, customer churn prediction, and revenue optimisation. Business intelligence analysts build AI-enhanced dashboards; analytics engineers build data transformation layers that feed ML models; quantitative analysts build statistical decision models. BCA AI & ML graduates who develop strong SQL, Python, and BI tool skills can access these applied AI roles in commercial enterprises across all industries.
